name: Fitness for Work
whoFor: Kirklees adults aged 18 and over who are out of work, off sick or at risk of falling out of work due to ill health. Fitness for Work aims to improve overall wellbeing and physical health, and to help more people to become and stay economically active.
eligibility: Committed to making a long term lifestyle change
Clinically stable and compliant with their medication

AND one of: out of work due to ill health and unable to look for work as a result; had sickness from work due to ill health for 7 or more days in the last 6 months; at risk of falling out of work due to ill health
exclusions: Systolic blood pressure over 180mmHg and/or diastolic over 100mmHg
Any other condition which may be exacerbated by exercise
gate: Clinically stable and compliant with their medication
referralRoutes: Internal rerouting of Fitness for Health referrals who meet the eligibility criteria
Workplace liaison, health days and direct engagement with key local employers

projects.name: Fitness for Work
projects.overview: A structured 12-week physical activity programme with one weekly exercise-specialist-led session (studio class, water-based class or gym session) plus full KAL membership for the duration. Aimed at people with health conditions who would benefit from being physically active. Individual support from a Specialist Exercise Co-ordinator and Exercise Referral Specialists.

sessions.note: Sessions run weekdays at a variety of KAL Leisure Centres

projects.name: Post 12 week programme
projects.overview: For completers of Fitness for Work, KAL's follow on memberships (full access) will be discussed on exiting the scheme, along with recommendations of suitable classes and groups, graduation events and gym floor support.
projects.cost: From £19 - £39 per month depending on membership choices
projects.places: Six KAL leisure centres across Kirklees

notes: Status before November 2026: Live - open to referrals Eligibility wording follows KAL's page (Nov 2026): '7 or more days' off sick in the last 6 months. Pathways v2.1 says 'more than 7 days'.
